item.title: Charter vote could come as early as July
item.description: Former state Sen. Bret Allain said, "It is time we make our parish look like the successful parishes around us." The Review/Howard Castay FRANKLIN — By mid-summer, voters parishwide could have a hand in changing the parish’s direction.

item.title: MC mosquito fee will take a bigger bite
item.description: Mayor Lee Dragna holds up documents showing that the price for a mosquito-spraying chemical has more than doubled since last year. The Review/Bill Decker It turns out mosquitoes can cause irritation in December, too.
